title: Didn’t like it
body: They write about money back policy but then do not return anything. Scamy
author: mosejevaite

title: Scammy app - WARNING
body:
I found the app confusing and not useful at all. The subscription terms on the website offers a free trial version(3 days) that does not show up in subscribed apps on icloud. Money back policy requires that you use the product for 21 days consecutively! So after the trial verslon the membership renews back automatically without any possibility of refund. 
It’s not worth it.
author: chehx

title: Be carefull
body: Be careful by choosing trial version. They do not inform when the trial ends and charge you more than you expect. Prices on ipad and iphone different. It is like phishing. App itself nothing special.
author: Mindaugas_Vilnius
